newsitem.title: USA: Ecopetrol seeks buyers for Vasconia, South Blend.
newsitem.headline: Ecopetrol seeks buyers for Vasconia, South Blend.

text.p: Colombia's state oil company Ecopetrol is seeking bids for two Vasconia and three South Blend crude oil cargoes, trade sources said Wednesday.
The two cargoes of Vasconia are scheduled to load November 3-7 and November 10-14, and are about 500,000 barrels each.
Ecopetrol has asked potential buyers for Vasconia, a heavy crude valued around West Texas Intermediate minus $1.90 a barrel fob on a spot basis, to be submitted by October 9.
Additionally, another sale tender for three cargoes of South Blend crude, one a month from November through January, closes today.
Traders said cargo sizes are typically 400,000 barrels each, but volumes into the U.S. Gulf via the Panama Canal will be adjusted down to suit shipping.
